facts.business: Centenial Surgical Suture Ltd. manufactures and sells sterile atraumatic needled sutures (absorbable and non-absorbable), with a specialized focus on cardiovascular sutures and over 310 product codes for CABG applications.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Inventory valuation and existence (Rs. 4,064.62 Lakhs, 50.94% of Total Assets) due to two consecutive years of net losses and declining revenues, risk of carrying value exceeding Net Realisable Value (NRV). Inventories hypothecated as primary security for working capital borrowings.

key_risks: Inventory valuation risk (carrying value exceeding NRV) due to consecutive losses and declining revenues
